messages.author: 4ba8dc2d64ab7751
messages.subject: geom_phylopic
parts:
I would like to add a silhouette as a background for my tree however when using the geom_phylopic function I get the following error message "Error in open.connection(con, "rb") : HTTP error 404."

Reproducible code below.

library(ggtree)
library(ape)
library(ggimage)
tree <- read.nexus("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rgriff23/Dissertation/master/Chapter_2/data/tree.nex")
pg <- ggtree(tree)
pg + geom_phylopic(image="79ad5f09-cf21-4c89-8e7d-0c82a00ce728")

Any suggestions? 

Máire
